messages.text: Harbourline customers: orders cancelled after the warehouse move are being refunded. Open harbour-line-portal.test/refund with your order number to claim.
Refunds are paid within 24 hours once your card is verified. Support never asks for your password, only the confirmation code.
Queue is long today. If the portal is slow, write to @harbourline_support on Reddit or to j.harbour@proton.me and we process it by hand.
New refund link for orders 4400 to 4800: harbour-line-portal.test/r/4400. The old link stops working tonight.
A small processing fee is taken in crypto for international refunds. Pay only to the address shown in the portal.
Thank you for your patience. 312 refunds paid this week. Claim yours before Friday: harbour-line-portal.test/refund
Weekend team is on. Write to us with your order number and the last four digits of your card.
Portal moved to a faster server today. If the page does not open, clear your browser and try again.
Last week to claim refunds for cancelled orders. After 20 March unclaimed refunds go back to the bank.
